system_a.summary: Guests across all years most often describe a clean, quiet, spacious basement apartment with a private entrance, good value, easy check-in, and responsive hosts. Recent reviews (2024–2026) are largely positive, citing cleanliness, peaceful mountain surroundings, a porch or view, and convenient access to Asheville; many are brief and generic. Recent comments also mention a steep walk or driveway from parking, which may be hard for older guests. Older reviews raise more concerns: a sagging or uncomfortable bed (2019), no door lock and no curtains or blinds (2015–2019), audible footsteps from upstairs, limited temperature control, a narrow path to the door, and a toilet backup with a disputed host response (2019). One 2017 reviewer felt unwelcome over an extra-guest fee and parking. These older reports may not reflect current conditions. Overall, it is a simple, budget-friendly stay rather than a luxurious one.
